title: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.2 Available
content: Spynixx Launcher v1.2.2 is now available for download.
This update restores SampVoice microphone detection for standalone SA-MP launches without requiring samp.exe.
Game startup is now faster, and Settings includes a native Windows microphone preflight with detected device names.
Open the official release page to download and install the latest MSI.
